prompt:
I need the front end for Pressline. A free national news app with tens of millions of readers that lets anyone follow developing stories and choose how and when they get alerted about them.

Who's using it: Gail Okonkwo, 44, a dental office manager in Harrisburg who reads news on her phone during lunch and in the evening. She isn't a news junkie and has turned off alerts in other apps because they buzzed too often.

What they're doing right now: Two stories she cares about are moving at once. The recount for her state house district, District 104, separated by 212 votes on election night, has county canvass results arriving through the week. Separately, the regional bus drivers' union has threatened a strike that would cancel her daughter's school route, with a vote set for Sunday. She wants to know right away if the recount flips or if the strike is confirmed. She doesn't want an alert for every precinct update or opinion column. She is catching up on what changed since yesterday and adjusting what is allowed to interrupt her.

What's in the system at this point: Gail follows 5 stories: 'District 104 recount' (14 updates in 3 days, latest 'Dauphin County canvass complete, margin now 187'), 'Capital Area Transit strike vote' (6 updates, vote Sun 23 Nov 2 pm), 'Eagles season', 'Susquehanna water-quality advisory' (resolved Nov 18), and 'Statewide minimum wage bill'. Each story has its follow date, update count, last-update time, and her alert setting (every update, major developments only, daily digest, off). In the last 7 days she got 31 alerts and opened 6. A breaking-news alert about a celebrity trial reached her through the app's default national alerts, which are still on. 4 unread updates since last night.

Build it as a working web app, opened in the state that person would see at that moment. No backend: use realistic mock data (no lorem ipsum, no placeholder names), and make the interactive parts actually work client-side.

Use whatever framework and tooling you like. When you're done there must be a static production build in ./out with ./out/index.html as the entry point. It will be served from the root of a plain static file server (no rewrites, no server code) and viewed in a desktop browser at 1440×900.
